balance_sheet_2026_06_30.share_count_caveat: Issued shares include restricted awards excluded from diluted EPS until earned; issued shares and diluted weighted averages are not interchangeable.

derived_trailing_12_months_through_2026_.eps_caveat: Reconstructed from rounded published period EPS, not a newly filed exact TTM EPS.
derived_trailing_12_months_through_2026_.fcf_less_sbc_caveat: Economic dilution sensitivity, not GAAP cash flow or a complete owner-earnings estimate; no double subtraction of SBC from GAAP EPS.

observable_businesses: Vehicle sales, leasing, software subscriptions, service and charging
unresolved_inputs: Separate sustainable Robotaxi/Optimus revenue, margins, capital needs and per-share cash generation
Fully normalized GAAP earnings after investment gains, currency changes, tax benefits and recurring SBC
Future restricted-award dilution and share-count path
business_separation.rule: Do not capitalize promotional addressable-market claims as achieved earnings; do not assume the unmeasured opportunities have zero value either.

reverse_valuation.purpose: Shows the future earnings hurdle implied by the observed price; does not estimate a fair value or exact sell price.
reverse_valuation.formula: required EPS at year N = observed price * (1 + required annual return)^N / terminal P/E
reverse_valuation.dividends: Assumed zero for this calculation; no separate cash addition because earnings include interest on cash.
reverse_valuation.terminal_multiple_rationale: 30x and 40x are explicit growth-company sensitivity assumptions, not observed comparables or proven fair multiples; 60x is a generous high-growth case and still requires durable growth beyond the horizon.
reverse_valuation.share_dilution: EPS requirements already incorporate whatever share count exists then. Dollar earnings examples hold the Q2 diluted weighted share count constant at 3.54B; more shares require proportionately more earnings.

assessment.classification: Speculative growth exposure, not an established value bargain on these current earnings and cash-flow figures.
assessment.action_framework: Do not sell simply at a recent chart high. Reassess if credible future per-share profits cannot support the price, if execution weakens, or if exposure exceeds an explicitly chosen risk budget.
assessment.why_no_exact_target: The present evidence does not support a precise intrinsic value for future autonomy and robotics; a made-up range would not fix arbitrary chart exits.
assessment.technical_role: Moving averages, volatility and support/resistance can guide review timing and staged execution. They are not intrinsic value or proof of a permanent business impairment.
